maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is mainly radio advertising, plus live events and TV; not repair, servicing or replacement work.

publicly_funded.reason: Radio and TV advertisers (private businesses) and event ticket buyers pay; not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grew via past market acquisitions, but now grows through its own radio, events and digital; recently selling Puerto Rico TV.

mission_critical.reason: Advertisers can easily move spend to other radio, TV or digital outlets; listeners switch stations freely.
